name: repository-health-assessment
description: Read-only repository health assessment: weighted coverage, lane maturity scorecards, an anchored A-F grade with caps and confidence, and a candidate ledger routed to the architecture and integrity skills.

depends_on.provides: canonical candidate contract, the eight 1-5 scores, priority_score, dedup rules, and lifecycle schema
executable verification and rendering of the candidate half of the shared spine
depends_on.failure_mode: verifyHealth reports ledger-module-missing; the report renders a red candidate panel and does not ship

known_risk: This package validates health provenance and delegates candidate scoring, dependency, eligibility, ranking, lifecycle, and rendering to the canonical shared spine. Missing or incompatible modules are hard failures.

dev_dependencies.ajv: ^8 — used only by assets/parity-check.js, never by the generated report
dev_dependencies.ledger-verify.js: required for parity-check.js and package-check.js; resolved from shared/candidate-ledger-spine or LEDGER_VERIFY_PATH
